PositionAndSpeedSensors.name: Crankshaft Position Sensor
PositionAndSpeedSensors.description: Detects crankshaft rotation speed and position for ignition timing.

PositionAndSpeedSensors.name: Camshaft Position Sensor
PositionAndSpeedSensors.description: Monitors camshaft position to control valve timing and fuel injection.

PositionAndSpeedSensors.name: Vehicle Speed Sensor
PositionAndSpeedSensors.description: Measures vehicle speed for ECU and transmission control.
PositionAndSpeedSensors.material: Magnetic sensor with gear wheel interface

TemperatureSensors.description: Monitors engine coolant temperature to regulate fan and fuel mixture.

TemperatureSensors.name: Intake Air Temperature Sensor
TemperatureSensors.description: Measures air temperature entering the engine for fuel-air adjustment.

TemperatureSensors.name: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor
TemperatureSensors.description: Monitors exhaust temperature to protect turbocharger and catalytic converter.

TemperatureSensors.name: Oil Temperature Sensor
TemperatureSensors.description: Measures engine oil temperature for lubrication and cooling control.

PressureAndFlowSensors.name: Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) Sensor
PressureAndFlowSensors.description: Measures air pressure in intake manifold for load calculation.

PressureAndFlowSensors.description: Measures the mass of air entering the engine for proper fuel ratio.

PressureAndFlowSensors.name: Fuel Pressure Sensor

PressureAndFlowSensors.name: Boost Pressure Sensor
PressureAndFlowSensors.description: Monitors turbocharger boost levels to avoid overpressure.

AdditionalSensors.name: Accelerator Pedal Position Sensor
AdditionalSensors.description: Measures pedal movement to control throttle electronically.

AdditionalSensors.name: Ambient Air Pressure Sensor
AdditionalSensors.description: Measures atmospheric pressure for ECU altitude adjustment.
